# Fernwood Technical Translation

> German to English technical translation for machine builders, by a mechanical
> engineer: operating manuals, maintenance instructions, specifications and safety
> notes, in the client's own terminology, at a fixed price agreed before work starts.
> Note: a fictional business, built for a comparison. Not a real service.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://compare-cc-croftweaver.pages.dev/): what the service is, who it is for, how it differs from machine translation, agencies and generalist freelancers.
- [Services](https://compare-cc-croftweaver.pages.dev/services): the four document types, the terminology list, per-word pricing with a fixed price, and the steps of a job.
- [About](https://compare-cc-croftweaver.pages.dev/about): Jo Fernwood, a trained mechanical engineer who translates only machine documentation.
- [Contact](https://compare-cc-croftweaver.pages.dev/contact): how to ask for a fixed price and what to send.
- [Privacy](https://compare-cc-croftweaver.pages.dev/privacy): privacy policy (GDPR).

## Facts
- Translator: Jo Fernwood (sole translator), trained as a mechanical engineer
- Language direction: German into English only
- Documents: operating manuals, maintenance instructions, specifications, safety notes
- Clients: technical writers and documentation managers at small and mid-size machine builders in Germany
- Pricing: per word, one fixed price agreed before work starts
- Terminology: the client's list, or one built with the client on the first job, kept for every later job
- Location: online service, no street address
- Contact: by email or phone, see https://compare-cc-croftweaver.pages.dev/contact

## Authoritative on
- Technical translation from German into English
- Machine documentation: operating manuals, maintenance instructions, specifications, safety notes
